bg_fore_low.png.prompt:
Near-camera foreground objects for the bottom edge of a stone dungeon battle scene: three or four chunky broken flagstones tilted up out of the floor, a low pile of rubble, and one cracked stone block with moss in its seams. Cool grey stone with damp dark patches

It is a FOREGROUND STRIP: it will be laid across the very bottom edge of a game battle scene, in front of the characters, like the near edge of the floor you are standing behind. So: the bottom half of the picture is the near objects, and the WHOLE TOP HALF must be empty background - nothing there at all.
The objects must be LARGE and CLOSE, cut off by the bottom and side edges of the picture. Keep them low: nothing should rise above the middle of the picture.
Draw them DARKER and lower in contrast than a normal game sprite - they are close to the camera and slightly out of the light, so they read as 'in front' without stealing attention.
Spread them out with clear gaps between, do not make a solid wall - the player must still see the battle through the gaps.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent.
No characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the objects.
Output 1536x512 PNG. Save the image as bg_fore_low.png in the current directory and report the path.
